Title: Revelation to the Quorum of the Twelve, 1834-07-25
Summary: This revelation addresses organizational restructuring within the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles, particularly regarding their mayordomies (stewardships) and responsibilities. It outlines the establishment of a sacred treasury for printing religious texts, while also setting guidelines for managing finances in conjunction with the broader community's needs. The document emphasizes the importance of paying debts through humility, prayer, and diligence, offering a 'sabbatical year' to alleviate financial burdens. Additionally, it instructs the Quorum on how to separate themselves from the main body of Saints as the organization evolves.
